current: An in-flight save whose settle flush fails keeps the document dirty but App still displays Saved for that write.
desired: A failed settle flush must not report an ordinary successful save; the user must see that the editor still has unsaved content.
reason: performSave uses the successful save_file result to show Saved even when applySaveResult demotes the result after a failed settle flush.

current: A save reply arriving after a same-id replacement rebaselines that replacement to the stale bytes; after a path move it restores the old path and marks the document clean.
desired: A save result started before replacement or path move must leave the newer document path, dirty state, and baseline untouched.
reason: The post-IPC result application checks baseline generation but does not recheck the document replacement epoch or path before applying the old result.
